details:
AGRIXON is a field decision-support platform created for the “Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data” challenge. It helps farmers understand what to plant next season by combining NASA Earth observations with local crop history and field-sensor measurements.

Farmers can draw or import a field, review climate and vegetation conditions, explore a 3D digital twin, and compare three crop-rotation scenarios focused on yield, water conservation, and soil recovery. AGRIXON uses NASA POWER climate data, NASA HLS and GIBS imagery, vegetation observations, and SRTM-derived terrain. Our working hardware prototype measures local soil moisture, soil temperature, air temperature, and humidity.

Every value is clearly identified as LIVE, LOCAL, CACHED, SIMULATED, or ILLUSTRATIVE so users understand its origin and limitations. AGRIXON turns complex space-based information into simple, practical explanations, helping farmers explore resilient crop choices while protecting soil and conserving water.
